coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are substantially matched (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware and resources, MAPPO versus QMIX, and wall-clock training time to a defined performance threshold.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The task selection does not specify the required nine maps excluding maps with more than 10 units, and explicitly includes large-unit scenarios. Normalized score uses random-baseline subtraction rather than score divided by the scenario maximum. Training time is not explicitly reported in minutes, and performance thresholds are used instead of an explicit convergence criterion. IPPO and VDN are also introduced beyond the specified algorithm pair.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios because of more stable training and more effective policy optimization.
